tools.description: Read project state as compact text. Read "brief <slug|path|file>" before working on a card, node, or file; "search <terms>" finds anything. The query field lists the other reads.

scope.description: Structure node path, slug, or id, or a list of them. The read keeps the union of each node, its descendants, and its ancestors. Omit for the whole project.

scope_exact.description: With scope, leave out each node's ancestors.

tools.name: polter.query

tools.description: Write Work cards, Structure nodes, and Rules from Polter text, or a canvas from its Mermaid source (canvas names it; read polter.format topic canvas once), in one audited write that joins this session's run. Needs summary and rationale (frontmatter or arguments). dry_run returns the plan.

canvas.description: Canvas name or id: text is then its Mermaid source, and an unknown name creates the canvas. A parse failure answers with its line and column.

text.description: Polter format text, or the canvas Mermaid source when canvas is set

tools.name: polter.apply

tools.description: Polter format core (about 360 tokens); read once before polter.apply. topic adds one part.
tools.name: polter.format

tools.description: Create or update a doc (Markdown body) in one audited write that joins this session's run. Pass id to update; omitted fields stay. scope lists the Structure paths the doc is about, comma separated (empty clears).
tools.name: doc.upsert
